hook_text: 25 plus 15 times 4. Is it 160 or 85? Half the class gets it wrong.
clip_script: 25 plus 15 times 4. Left to right gives 160. But the rule says times before plus! 15 times 4 is 60, plus 25 is 85. Think of a fruit stall in Durban: R25 float, then 15 bags of oranges at R4. Oranges first: R60. Then the float: R85. Want to add first? Use brackets! (25 plus 15) times 4 is 160. Brackets first, then times and divide, then plus and minus. One order, one answer, every time.
visual_style: Calculations lighting up in the order they are worked out: brackets glow first, then multiplication signs, then plus and minus.
mood: Quiz-show energy with a satisfying reveal.
pacing: A pause for viewers to choose an answer, a quick reveal, then the brackets twist.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the change for three adult and two child tickets.
